Name: LN Chocolate and Bonbons CP Conversion
Author: AnnyaSade
Description:
I've been learning Content Patcher modding, and slowly replacing JsonAssets mods with updates ones. There wasn't a conversion of these crops and recipes, so I decided to make my own! I'm uploading this conversion with permission from the original author, Lunightmare. Please Endorse the original mods~
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19294]10 Recipes For Chocolate Bonbons at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20173]Pink Chocolate Bonbons Recipes at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20171]Pink Chocolate Crop at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19287]Chocolate Crops at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community

[/url]These are conversions, but I made some small edits to the prices of certain bonbons, edited some grammar, and edited the recipe of one bonbon from the 'pink chocolate bonbons' mod to include milk chocolate from the 'chocolate crops' mod. I have tested these in-game and the recipes, crop stages, and gift tastes all seem to work, but that said, this is the first mod I'm sharing, so if anything is broken let me know!
